title.en: Realisation Account and its journal entries
title.kn: ವಸೂಲಾತಿ ಖಾತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಅದರ ದಿನಚರಿ ನಮೂದುಗಳು

hook.en: Stock sold below cost, machinery sold above book value, creditors settled at a discount — where do all these gains and losses meet?
hook.kn: ಸರಕು ಕಡಿಮೆ ಬೆಲೆಗೆ, ಯಂತ್ರ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಬೆಲೆಗೆ ಮಾರಾಟ, ಸಾಲಗಾರರಿಗೆ ರಿಯಾಯಿತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪಾವತಿ — ಈ ಲಾಭ ನಷ್ಟಗಳೆಲ್ಲ ಎಲ್ಲಿ ಸೇರುತ್ತವೆ?

objectives.en: Know which items are transferred to the Realisation Account
Pass journal entries for realisation of assets and payment of liabilities

narration.en: Stock sold below cost, machinery sold above book value, creditors settled at a discount — where do all these gains and losses meet? In the Realisation Account.
narration.kn: ಸರಕು ಕಡಿಮೆ ಬೆಲೆಗೆ, ಯಂತ್ರ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಬೆಲೆಗೆ ಮಾರಾಟ, ಸಾಲಗಾರರಿಗೆ ರಿಯಾಯಿತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪಾವತಿ — ಈ ಲಾಭ ನಷ್ಟಗಳೆಲ್ಲ ಎಲ್ಲಿ ಸೇರುತ್ತವೆ? ವಸೂಲಾತಿ ಖಾತೆಯಲ್ಲಿ.

body.en: All assets except cash, bank and fictitious assets are transferred to the debit of the Realisation Account at book value; provisions against them go to the credit. All outside liabilities are transferred to the credit. Partners' loans, capitals, reserves and accumulated losses are not transferred: reserves and losses go to capital accounts in the profit sharing ratio, and partners' loans are paid separately.
body.kn: ನಗದು, ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್ ಮತ್ತು ಕಾಲ್ಪನಿಕ ಆಸ್ತಿಗಳನ್ನು ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಎಲ್ಲ ಆಸ್ತಿಗಳು ವಸೂಲಾತಿ ಖಾತೆಯ ಖರ್ಚು ಬದಿಗೆ; ಹೊರಗಿನ ಹೊಣೆಗಳು ಜಮಾ ಬದಿಗೆ. ಪಾಲುದಾರರ ಸಾಲ, ಬಂಡವಾಳ, ಮೀಸಲುಗಳು ವಸೂಲಾತಿ ಖಾತೆಗೆ ಹೋಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.

title.en: On the board: The Realisation Account

narration.en: Assets other than cash go to the debit at book value. Outside liabilities go to the credit.

say.en: Assets other than cash go to the debit at book value. Outside liabilities go to the credit.
Whatever is paid out is debited; whatever comes in, or is taken by a partner, is credited.
Not transferred: cash, partners' loans, capitals, reserves and accumulated losses.

text.en: Not here: cash, loans, capitals, reserves
Balance = profit or loss, in PSR

say.en: Now the entries. A takes stock worth fifteen thousand at twelve thousand: his capital is debited with twelve thousand.
Creditors of forty thousand are paid at five per cent discount: thirty-eight thousand.
Expenses paid by partner B for the firm are credited to his capital, not to bank.

body.en: Asset sold: Bank Dr, To Realisation. Asset taken by a partner: Partner's Capital Dr, To Realisation. Liability paid: Realisation Dr, To Bank. Liability taken over by a partner: Realisation Dr, To Partner's Capital. Expenses paid by the firm: Realisation Dr, To Bank; paid by a partner on the firm's behalf: Realisation Dr, To Partner's Capital. Profit or loss on realisation is shared in the profit sharing ratio.
body.kn: ಆಸ್ತಿ ಮಾರಾಟ: ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್ ಖರ್ಚು, ವಸೂಲಾತಿಗೆ ಜಮಾ. ಪಾಲುದಾರ ಆಸ್ತಿ ಪಡೆದರೆ: ಅವನ ಬಂಡವಾಳ ಖರ್ಚು. ಹೊಣೆ ಪಾವತಿ: ವಸೂಲಾತಿ ಖರ್ಚು, ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್‌ಗೆ ಜಮಾ. ವೆಚ್ಚಗಳು ವಸೂಲಾತಿ ಖಾತೆಗೆ ಖರ್ಚು. ಲಾಭ ನಷ್ಟ ಲಾಭ ಹಂಚಿಕೆ ಅನುಪಾತದಲ್ಲಿ.

caption.en: Creditors are settled at a discount, and a partner takes over stock below book value. See how each affects the Realisation Account.

narration.en: Paying a creditor less than the book figure is a gain on realisation; a partner taking an asset below book value is a loss.

label.en: Price at which A takes stock

tryThis.en: Defaults: creditors paid ₹38,000; gain ₹2,000; loss on stock ₹3,000.
At what stock price is there no loss on stock?
Which entry records A taking the stock, and which side of the Realisation Account does it reach?

problem.en: Pass journal entries on dissolution: (a) stock of book value ₹15,000 is taken over by partner A at ₹12,000; (b) creditors of ₹40,000 are paid at a 5% discount; (c) realisation expenses of ₹3,000 are paid by partner B on behalf of the firm.

steps.en: (a) A's Capital A/c Dr 12,000; To Realisation A/c 12,000.
(b) Payment = 40,000 − 5% = ₹38,000: Realisation A/c Dr 38,000; To Bank A/c 38,000.
(c) Realisation A/c Dr 3,000; To B's Capital A/c 3,000.

narration.en: Let us work this out together, step by step. Pass journal entries on dissolution: (a) stock of book value ₹15,000 is taken over by partner A at ₹12,000; (b) creditors of ₹40,000 are paid at a 5% discount; (c) realisation expenses of ₹3,000 are paid by partner B on behalf of the firm.
